title: Machu Picchu
description:
Live the ultimate experience to the most emblematic Inca citadel in the world. This Full Day tour takes you from Cusco by panoramic train to Aguas Calientes, and from there by bus to the entrance of Machu Picchu, where an official guide will show you the temples, plazas and terraces of this World Wonder.
An unforgettable day of history, nature and Andean culture.
shortItinerary: Hotel pick-up in Cusco (4:00 - 4:30 a. m.)
Panoramic train ride to Aguas Calientes
25-minute bus ride up to the citadel
Return by bus, train and transfer to your hotel

paragraphs.text: The day starts very early with the pickup from your hotel and the transfer to the train station to reach the Inca citadel.
items: Pick-up from your hotel between 4:00 and 4:30 a. m.
Private transfer to the train station in Ollantaytambo or Poroy
Panoramic train ride with breakfast on board to Aguas Calientes
Bus ride along the winding road up to the citadel

paragraphs.text:
Once inside the citadel, the guided tour of its main temples and plazas begins.
During the tour you will have time for photos at the official viewpoints.
items: Entry to Machu Picchu and approximately 2-hour guided tour
Temple of the Sun and Temple of the Three Windows

paragraphs.text: After the tour you will have free time to have lunch in Aguas Calientes and buy souvenirs before heading back.
items: Free time for photos at the Sun Gate and the viewpoints
Bus ride down to Aguas Calientes and free lunch time
Return train to Cusco and transfer to your hotel

included: Pick-up and drop-off from and to your hotel in Cusco
Round-trip train ticket (Expedition class or similar)
Official entrance to the citadel of Machu Picchu
Round-trip bus Aguas Calientes - Machu Picchu
Bilingual official guide throughout the tour
Bottle of water on board the train
notIncluded: Additional entrances: Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain
Tips for the guide and driver
recommendations: Original passport or ID (mandatory for entry)
Layered comfortable clothing and walking shoes
Insect repellent and reusable water bottle

items.name: Typical lunch in Aguas Calientes
items.description:
Typical Andean buffet in the heart of Aguas Calientes.
Vegetarian and gluten-free options available.
